compiled_state.description:
Scope: `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/**` (38 files) and `src/rebar/llm/workflow/**` (26 files). ~230 lines leave of 24,304 LOC — only 0.9%, because this subtree's prose is unusually load-bearing (fail-open/fail-closed contracts, byte-compat pins, patch-seam invariants).

36 of 38 history blocks already cite a ticket id, so most of the work is 'reduce to the citation'. Only two are costly: untracked follow-ups in `production_batch_runner.py` that must be filed first.

Verified stale: SIX sites say 'the deterministic floor (P1-P9)' while `DET_CHECKS` has 11 entries and `registry.CANONICAL_DET` runs P1..P11; `orchestrator.py:9` additionally misstates which checks block. `reuse.py:36-37` cites four line numbers, all four wrong.

Three new ADRs: the unversioned additive-only attestation manifest; the Burr tripwire (a 4-condition adoption trigger list spread across three docstrings, with a test asserting the prose exists); gate context is never elided (including a WITHDRAWN alternative documented as a signed-false-PASS vector).

Biggest headroom win: `workflow/executor.py` 791 -> ~769, almost entirely from three 'so this module stays under the module-size cap' notes.

Byte-pinned json.dumps rationale in attest.py/pass1.py is maintainer-blessed and must stay verbatim — converging it would invalidate live attestations.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every non-KEEP unit in scope is relocated or deleted per its destination
- [ ] The shard's do_not_move list is appended to `.joe-janitor/tools.md` BEFORE any edit lands
- [ ] Verified-stale comments are corrected where they document a live invariant, deleted only where obsolete
- [ ] No load-bearing invariant is lost; measured-fact and anti-refactor warnings stay verbatim
